messages:
maria.pm: Starting a controlled gradient shift from green -> blue. Target release v2.4.1. Plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% over ~30m (10m steps). Change window: 22:30-23:30 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.4.1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy command queued: `deploy service router-pool --version v2.4.1 --strategy gradient --steps 10,25,50 --window 60m` (id: dpl-7821)

sam.eng: Preflight checks running. Please confirm p95 and error-rate baselines within the last 15m.

sre-lead: Preflight: p95 latency +5ms vs baseline, 5xx at 0.02% (stable). No memory pressure on nodes. Query used:
``
SELECT p95_latency, error_rate FROM metrics.router WHERE window='15m'
```
All green from our side :thumbsup:

router-ops: Applying initial weight for step 1. Commands:
``
routerctl set-weight --pool blue --weight 10
routerctl set-weight --pool green --weight 90
```

deploy-bot: traffic-shift step 1 complete — blue=10% (dpl-7821). Monitoring.

ben.ops: Seeing elevated retransmits from clients in eu-west3 around 22:34 UTC, small spike in tcp retries. Suggest pausing ramp and holding at 10% for investigation. @sre-lead @router-ops

maria.pm: Acknowledged. Pausing ramp. We'll pin remaining traffic and roll back eu-west3 if needed. Updating change-window note.

sam.eng: To pin regionally run:
`routerctl pin-version --region eu-west3 --version v2.3.9 --reason "regional rollback due to retransmits"`

router-ops: pin command issued for eu-west3 -> v2.3.9. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Pin applied for eu-west3. Remaining global traffic held at blue=10%.

sre-lead: We'll keep an eye for 30m. If 5xx >0.5% or retransmits persist, escalate and rollback entirely. Opening incident channel if thresholds breach.

carla.pm: I'll post an update to CS and note partial rollout + regional hold. Adding annotation to release notes.

maria.pm: Tentative resume plan: after triage, resume ramp in a 60m safety window: step to 25% (monitor 10m) then 50% if stable. If issue is network-specific, we'll re-route region or adjust LB weights regionally. Agree? :hand:

ben.ops: Agree. I'll run packet captures and check peering for eu-west3. Will report back in ~15-20m.

maria.pm: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the source of truth. If anyone needs to force-rollback, use `deploy-bot rollback dpl-7821 --immediate` and @pagerduty to wake ops.

sam.eng: Noted. I'll prep the rollback playbook snippet in case.

deploy-bot: Logged actions: step1 completed, regional pin applied. dpl-7821 state=paused

maria.pm: Closing interim note — will update when we have root-cause. :eyes:
